bar.archived: the source repo is archived: unarchive it, or hand the plugin to a new maintainer
bar.cpu-bench: run the CPU bench (docs/BENCH.md) so the release records a figure
bar.cpu-fail: bring the CPU use down (the bench verdict is FAIL)
bar.issues-unanswered: answer the issues that have waited more than 60 days with no reply
bar.screenshot: add a screenshot of the plugin screen to the registry entry
bar.tested: add a tested.json entry for the newest release on a Gen1 device (device and MPC OS version)
bar.tested-gen2: add a tested.json entry for the newest release's Gen2 build (a device naming Gen2, e.g. "MPC Live III (Gen2)")
bar.tested-sample: add a tested.json entry for the newest release on an MPC Sample (device "MPC Sample")
